releaseNotes:
CineMovie v0.9.3 — Download/Export Fix & Minor Improvements

Downloads & Export:
• Fixed downloaded movies and episodes not matching the exact resolution you picked, and fixed offline playback errors on newly downloaded videos.
• Fixed exporting downloaded movies and episodes to your device so audio and video save reliably with live progress.
• Still having a download fail or an export problem? Press and hold on the Failed button on a download — or press and hold on the Export button — to open the live Diagnostics Console and send us a report.

Streaming & Servers:
• Fixed the issue where streaming servers could crash or stop working after ~5 minutes of playback.
• Fixed VidSrc PM, VidSrc Top, and switching back to KissKH on Asian dramas.

New Feature — Share:
• Tap the new Share button on any Movie or TV Show page to create a live link from your phone and watch on any PC or browser with synced playback and remote controls.

Profile & Minor Fixes:
• Added profile picture border customization in Profile Settings (choose your border style, color, or None).
• Fixed the Rate button on Movie & TV Show pages and fixed the delete popup in Downloads overlapping the bottom navigation bar.
